newsitem.title: USA: NYS deputy comptroller for NYC resigns - McCall.
newsitem.headline: NYS deputy comptroller for NYC resigns - McCall.

text.p: New York State Comptroller H. Carl McCall said on Friday that Deputy State Comptroller for New York City Rosemary Scanlon was resigning to take a consultancy job in London.

McCall said Scanlon will take a consultancy spot in London after the annual meeting of the New York City Financial Control Board on July 17. The state comptroller said he soon would name an interim appointment to replace Scanlon.

Scanlon, the former chief economist of the Port Authority of New York and New Jersey, was appointed by McCall in June 1993. The position was created during New York City's financial crisis in the mid-1970s to serve as the state's permanent monitor of the New York City budget.
